title: Meet Kafka
description: Why publish/subscribe messaging matters, and how messages, topics, partitions, producers, consumers, brokers, and clusters fit together.

title: Installing Kafka
description: Setting up ZooKeeper and Kafka brokers, the broker and topic defaults worth tuning, and choosing hardware and cluster size for production.

title: Kafka Producers: Writing Messages to Kafka
description: How producers write to Kafka: sending records, configuring acknowledgments and retries, serializing with Avro and a schema registry, and partitioning.

title: Kafka Consumers: Reading Data from Kafka
description: How consumers read from Kafka: consumer groups and rebalances, the poll loop, committing offsets, and reacting when partitions are reassigned.

title: Managing Apache Kafka Programmatically
description: Using the AdminClient to create and inspect topics, change configurations, manage consumer groups, and read cluster metadata from code.

title: Kafka Internals
description: How Kafka works under the hood: the controller, replication, request processing, and how partitions are stored as segments, indexes, and compacted logs.

title: Reliable Data Delivery
description: The reliability guarantees Kafka makes, and how to configure brokers, producers, and consumers so no message is lost, then validate it.

title: Exactly-Once Semantics
description: How idempotent producers and transactions combine to give exactly-once processing, and where those guarantees stop.

title: Building Data Pipelines
description: Moving data between systems with Kafka and Kafka Connect, weighing timeliness, reliability, throughput, data formats, and transformations.

title: Cross-Cluster Data Mirroring
description: Replicating data between clusters with MirrorMaker, and the multicluster architectures it enables, from hub and spoke to active-active.

title: Securing Kafka
description: Protecting a deployment with encryption, authentication, authorization, auditing, and quotas, including ZooKeeper and the platform around it.

title: Administering Kafka
description: Day to day operations with the command line tools: topics, consumer groups, dynamic configuration, partition management, and unsafe operations.

title: Monitoring Kafka
description: Which broker, client, and lag metrics to watch, how to set service-level objectives, and how to alert on what actually matters.

title: Stream Processing
description: Processing data as it arrives with Kafka Streams: time, state, windows, joins, and the design patterns that let stream processing scale.
